name: Jurai Wohdel
original_name: ジュライ・ウォーデル
source:
A reserved and shy young woman. She have been living in a lodge with only her grandfather, who keeps sheep.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
